title: Design System: Ali Ikram — AI Specialist & Founder

bg.note: Base tone for Hero, Nav, and project cards. Other sections use their own flat wash hex: ventures #f9eecd, intro #ffeebd, about #f8e6b4, experience #fbe6a7, projects #f9e29f, skills #fbe193.

display.purpose: Hero name only — the single largest text on the page.

headline.purpose: Section titles (Ventures, About, Experience, Featured Projects, Technical Skills).

pullquote.purpose: The hero's italic role line — the system's one italic moment.

title.purpose: Card and log titles, contact/transmission headings, nav logo.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy across hero, about, ventures, log, projects, contact.

label.purpose: Nav links, timestamps, fact-list field names, footer, uppercase metadata.

motion.name: reveal-fade-rise
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered entrance for section content via IntersectionObserver; the system's only motion signature.

motion.name: media-desaturate
motion.value: filter grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) brightness(1.02), transition filter .3s, filter:none on hover/focus-within
motion.purpose: Keeps embedded YouTube demo thumbnails quiet inside the single-accent palette until engaged.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The site's only filled element; used exactly twice (Get in touch, Email me).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: .02em; padding: 14px 28px; background: #16213e; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid #16213e; transition: opacity .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { opacity: .85; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Text Link Button
components.description: Secondary action: underlined ink text, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #17181a; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid #17181a; padding-bottom: 2px; transition: opacity .2s; } .ds-btn-text:hover, .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { opacity: .6; }

components.name: Section Rule
components.description: 40x1px ink hairline preceding every section title. Pure graphic mark, carries no text and is not a category/eyebrow label.
components.css: .ds-kicker-rule { width: 40px; height: 1px; background: #17181a; margin-bottom: 22px; } .ds-section-title { font-family: Spectral, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 42px); color: #17181a; letter-spacing: -.01em; margin: 0; }

components.name: Fact List Row
components.description: Top-ruled, row-divided label/value pairs used once in About; the system's one data-pair pattern.
components.html: RoleAI Specialist, Founder
components.css: .ds-fact-list { border-top: 1px solid #dfdbd1; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-fact-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #dfdbd1; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-fact-label { color: #8b8d8e; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; font-size: 11.5px; } .ds-fact-value { color: #17181a; text-align: right; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Grid-seamed card with no owned border; the shared 1px background gap between grid cells draws the seam. Contains a desaturated video frame.
components.html:
Project Title

Project description text.
components.css: .ds-file-card { background: #faf9f6; padding: 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-file-title { font-family: Spectral, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; color: #17181a; font-size: 21px; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-file-copy { font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; color: #5b5d5f; margin-bottom: 22px; } .ds-video-frame { position: relative; width: 100%; padding-bottom: 56.25%; border: 1px solid #dfdbd1; overflow: hidden; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-video-frame iframe { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) brightness(1.02); transition: filter .3s; } .ds-video-frame:hover iframe, .ds-video-frame:focus-within iframe { filter: none; }

components.description: Fixed, translucent, blurred top bar with uppercase Public Sans links and a hamburger toggle below 768px (carried logic, unverified narrow-viewport render this session).

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a well-set executive dossier, not an app or an instrument panel: warm off-white paper, near-black ink, and a single deep-navy accent held in reserve for the one thing the visitor is asked to do. A large serif name and role open the page; one editorial paragraph follows; then a filled navy button and a quiet underlined text link, side by side, with nothing else competing for attention. This is a deliberate double refusal — of the generic dark-navy gradient 'AI portfolio' template, and of this project's own prior identity, a phosphor-green radar/ATC instrument scope. Neither survives in the built page.

Spectral (serif) carries every display, heading, and pull-quote moment. Public Sans, the U.S. federal government's typeface, carries every structural and body string, chosen for its plain, institutional trust register rather than for warmth. Hierarchy is built from type scale, hairline rules, and whitespace, never from color or shadow.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground (#faf9f6), near-black ink, one deep-navy accent (#16213e) reserved for the primary action only.
Spectral for display/heading/pull-quote text, Public Sans for everything structural — never mixed within a single string.
Hairline rules instead of borders, cards, or shadows; whitespace and rule-lines carry hierarchy.
Zero border-radius except true circular list-bullet dots; zero box-shadow anywhere in the system.
Embedded YouTube demo thumbnails are held desaturated at rest and restored to color only on hover/focus, so they never compete with the palette.
The page closes on a deep-navy full-bleed band (Contact + footer), the system's one committed color field.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Navy signals trust and carries the primary action; garnet signals luxury and never appears as a large fill except on the navy band. A hover state, rule mark, or highlighted figure is always garnet; a primary action is always navy, or garnet-on-navy as its one inversion.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px solid var(--line) rules (faint garnet on the navy band), not with card backgrounds, box-shadow, or heavier borders.

rules.name: The Crisp-Not-Blurred Rule
rules.body: Garnet hover/accent marks are a solid 1px ring, underline, or color change, never a blurred glow.

rules.name: The Serif-Is-Voice Rule
rules.body: If a string is a name, a section title, a card title, or the hero's role line, it renders in Spectral. If it is a paragraph, a label, a timestamp, or a navigation string, it renders in Public Sans.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing in this system lifts off the page. There is no card background distinct from the page background, no shadow, and no blur except the nav bar's backdrop-filter, which exists for legibility, not depth.

dos: Do keep navy for trust (primary actions, the closing band) and garnet for luxury (rule marks, hover states, proof figures) — never swap which job each accent does.
Do draw structure with 1px hairline rules instead of borders, card backgrounds, or shadows.
Do hold embedded video thumbnails at grayscale(1) contrast(1.05) brightness(1.02) and restore full color only on hover/focus-within.
Do keep corners sharp (0 radius) everywhere except the true circular log-entry bullet dot.
Do use an en dash for date ranges ("2023 – 2024"), not a comma or an em dash.
Do keep visible copy free of em dashes and of AI-writing tells — buzzwords, hedge phrases, formulaic constructions.
Do keep garnet accent marks crisp and solid, never a blurred glow.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, gradients, glassmorphism, or a secondary panel background.
Don't let garnet become a large fill on the paper ground, or navy appear as body text/decoration there — each accent keeps one job. Garnet only fills on the navy band.
Don't use rounded corners on cards, buttons, panels, or frames.
Don't reintroduce eyebrow, kicker-label, or category-tag text above titles — nine such tags were built, flagged in review, and removed entirely; this is a corrected defect, not a component.
Don't apply garnet .stat styling to a figure that isn't a real, sourced achievement.
